open_requests_to_borrower: FCCR reinstatement-readiness analysis (Stabilization Milestone M4), due to the lender 2026-09-30.
unresolved_flags: FCCR reinstatement at 1.2000x effective 2027-01-01 is this spec's best-supported reading of the suspension text, not a confirmed mechanism -- revisit before year-end, especially once the M4 analysis is delivered.

EBITDA add-back ($553,353.26/month) inside the borrower's certified 'Covenant EBITDA' is not supported by any agreement text located to date -- excluded from this analysis's EBITDA definition; resolve if a longer-form credit agreement surfaces.

Restructuring accounting (TDR framework, instrument-level 10% modification test, CODI, Section 382) remains PROVISIONAL through the June 2026 package -- successor balance-sheet figures could still restate.
Interim goodwill reassessment required as of 2026-03-31 had not been completed as of the June 2026 package.

analyst_focus.item: FCCR reinstatement readiness (Milestone M4 due 2026-09-30) and the informational FCCR trend
analyst_focus.finding: Informational FCCR worsened again to 0.3682x at June 2026 (from 0.67x in Q1 2026), fourth straight worsening quarter since the Dec 2025 suspension; the covenant remains suspended (not a breach) and M4 is due in about two weeks.

analyst_focus.item: EBITDA definition gap ($553,353.26/month unsupported add-back) and Fixed Charges scope gap vs certified figures
analyst_focus.finding: Confirmed unresolved: no executed document supports the add-back or a broader Fixed Charges definition; both remain excluded from this analysis and flagged for resolution if a longer-form agreement surfaces.

analyst_focus.item: Watchlist trajectory: improving operating metrics vs worsening informational FCCR
analyst_focus.finding: Operating metrics kept improving in June (EBITDA +23.3% MoM, gross margin up to 33.5%, revenue +2.2% MoM) even as the informational FCCR kept worsening -- trajectory 'improving' still holds on the operating side, but the covenant path has not yet turned.

last_period_headline: June 2026: revenue $13.2M ran 17.4% below the Approved Stabilization Budget while EBITDA $1.5M beat budget by 19.9%; Minimum Liquidity passed at $18.8M vs the $10.0M floor; the informational FCCR (0.3682x, suspended/not tested) continued to worsen ahead of the FCCR reinstatement-readiness milestone due 2026-09-30.
